text: じぶんの　いる　ばしょや　まちの　なまえが　しりたいとき　タウンマップ　つかうと　いいわよ

structure.jp: じぶんの　いる　ばしょや　まちの　なまえが　しりたいとき
structure.en: when you want to know where you are and town names

structure.jp: タウンマップ　つかうと　いいわよ
structure.en: it's good to use the Town Map

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: じぶんの　いる　ばしょ
patterns.explanation: A plain verb placed before a noun describes that noun. じぶんのいるばしょ = 'the place where you are'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい says you want to do it. しりたいとき = 'when you want to know'.

patterns.name: 〜と (condition)
patterns.span: つかうと　いいわよ
patterns.explanation: と after a verb plus いい says 'it's good if you do that'. つかうといい = 'it's good to use it'.
